textRuns.value: Height and weight are recorded for only 12% to 31% of athletes before 1960 and 94% or more afterwards, so trends start at 1960. Summer Games only, because Winter athletes are shorter and the alternating cycle after 1994 otherwise produces a sawtooth. The sport chart covers the 45 sports with 500 or more entries, and runs from gymnastics at 162.9 cm to basketball at 190.9 cm. Median medallist age runs from 21 in swimming to 34 in equestrianism, across sports with 200 or more medal rows.
